deals.proOnly: Sell it today comes with the Pro plan: put a dish on offer until later today.

errors.time: Choose a time at least 5 minutes from now, within the next 24 hours.
errors.failed: Could not start the deal. Please try again.

kitchen.title: Kitchen
kitchen.intro: Orders from your menu. Move each one along; the diner sees it on their phone.
kitchen.cancelConfirm: Cancel order {number}? The diner will see it was cancelled.
kitchen.offMode: Your menu isn't sending orders to the kitchen. Choose "Send to kitchen" in How diners order.
kitchen.proOnly: The kitchen screen comes with the Pro plan.
kitchen.failed: Could not update the order. Please try again.
kitchen.offSwitch: Sending orders to the kitchen is switched off at the moment. Orders already here can still be moved along.

switches.title: Features
switches.intro: Turn features on or off for every restaurant. Changes show straight away, with no redeploy. Turning a feature back on brings everything back as it was: nothing is deleted.
switches.saved: Saved. Menus and dashboards show it now.
switches.failed: Could not save. Please try again.

specials.name: Specials and "Sell it today"
specials.description: Daily specials, happy hours and today-only deals at the top of the menu.

order_waiter.name: Show to waiter
order_waiter.description: Diners show their order to a waiter on their phone, with the table number. A way of ordering.

order_whatsapp.name: Send on WhatsApp
order_whatsapp.description: Diners send their order to the restaurant's WhatsApp. Delivery orders always use this. A way of ordering.

order_kitchen.name: Send to kitchen
order_kitchen.description: Orders go straight to the kitchen screen, and diners see when theirs is ready. A way of ordering.

payments.name: MoMo codes and Pay with cash
payments.description: Shows the restaurant's MTN and Airtel merchant codes and the cash option.

waiter_call.name: Call waiter / Bring the bill
waiter_call.description: Buttons that send the waiter a WhatsApp message with the table number.

ratings.name: Ratings
ratings.description: Diners rate their visit from 1 to 5 stars, with a private comment for the owner.

loyalty.name: Loyalty points
loyalty.description: Diners collect a stamp each day they order and get a reward the owner chooses.

christmas.name: Christmas theme
christmas.description: A festive look for the menu: a garland, snow and a Christmas greeting. Owners switch it on for their own menu.

menu_import.name: Menu from a photo
menu_import.description: Owners photograph their paper menu and Menyu types it up for them to check.

insights.name: Insights
insights.description: Menu views, busy hours, most viewed dishes and orders, for owners.

kitchen_screen.name: Kitchen screen
kitchen_screen.description: New, Cooking and Ready orders on a phone or tablet in the kitchen.

directory.name: Menus near me directory
directory.description: The public list of restaurant menus by area, food and price.

rankings.name: Area rankings
rankings.description: "Top in your area this week" in Menus near me, by menu visits and orders.

restaurant.title: Features
restaurant.intro: Change a feature for this restaurant only. A feature works here only if it is on globally and not turned off here.
restaurant.ownerChoice: Available: the owner hasn't switched it on
restaurant.christmasOn: On here shows the theme even if the owner hasn't switched it on.
restaurant.onWaits: Set to On, but it stays off while the global switch is off.
restaurant.notListed: Not listed: their Menus near me listing isn't approved

switches.unavailableBody: This isn't available at the moment. Anything you set up is kept and comes back when it's switched on again.
